I’ll run the scan and check both sides of the contract, then rank the mismatches by their production impact.

The source shows more mismatches than the scan caught: an undeclared read path, literal `:id` URLs, and missing request data. I’ll check the router’s responses and whether the plan types actually enforce the scanner’s claimed rejections.

Ran `crimes scan --format json` and inspected all three source files. The scan’s five findings miss several contract defects. Ranked by confirmed production impact:

1. **High — workspace reads and creation return 404.**  
   The client requests `GET /api/workspaces/{id}` and `POST /api/workspaces`; the API exposes `/api/teams/{team_id}` and `/api/teams`. Both operations fail. The scan caught only creation because the read URL is concatenated. Align both paths.  
   [Client:18–23](/private/var/folders/8_/6tdb3p2s63v_xxb15r46cqwr0000gn/T/crimes-eval-agent-2oH6bA/packages/web/src/workspace-client.ts:18) · [API:10–16](/private/var/folders/8_/6tdb3p2s63v_xxb15r46cqwr0000gn/T/crimes-eval-agent-2oH6bA/packages/api/billing/routes.py:10)

2. **High — every plan change returns 405.**  
   `changeWorkspacePlan` sends `PUT`; the API declares `POST`. Align the method, alongside the additional plan-request defects below.  
   [Client:34](/private/var/folders/8_/6tdb3p2s63v_xxb15r46cqwr0000gn/T/crimes-eval-agent-2oH6bA/packages/web/src/workspace-client.ts:34) · [API:25](/private/var/folders/8_/6tdb3p2s63v_xxb15r46cqwr0000gn/T/crimes-eval-agent-2oH6bA/packages/api/billing/routes.py:25)

3. **High — creation still returns 422 after correcting its path.**  
   The client sends no body; `create_team(payload: dict)` requires a JSON object. An empty object satisfies the current handler. Agree on and send the creation payload.  
   [Client:23](/private/var/folders/8_/6tdb3p2s63v_xxb15r46cqwr0000gn/T/crimes-eval-agent-2oH6bA/packages/web/src/workspace-client.ts:23) · [API:16](/private/var/folders/8_/6tdb3p2s63v_xxb15r46cqwr0000gn/T/crimes-eval-agent-2oH6bA/packages/api/billing/routes.py:16)

4. **High — plan changes still return 422 after correcting the method.**  
   The client ignores its `plan` argument. FastAPI interprets the API’s `plan: str` as a required **query parameter**, which the request omits. Send it there, or explicitly change both sides to a JSON-body contract.  
   [Client:33–34](/private/var/folders/8_/6tdb3p2s63v_xxb15r46cqwr0000gn/T/crimes-eval-agent-2oH6bA/packages/web/src/workspace-client.ts:33) · [API:26](/private/var/folders/8_/6tdb3p2s63v_xxb15r46cqwr0000gn/T/crimes-eval-agent-2oH6bA/packages/api/billing/routes.py:26)

5. **Medium — seat and plan requests use the literal team ID `:id`.**  
   Both functions ignore their `id` argument. `fetch` does not substitute route placeholders; FastAPI accepts `:id` as the actual string identifier. The seat endpoint currently returns `200 {"seats":1}`, masking the defect because it ignores the identifier. After fixing the method and query parameter, the plan endpoint echoes `"id":":id"`. Interpolate and URL-encode the supplied ID in both URLs.  
   [Client:28](/private/var/folders/8_/6tdb3p2s63v_xxb15r46cqwr0000gn/T/crimes-eval-agent-2oH6bA/packages/web/src/workspace-client.ts:28) · [Client:34](/private/var/folders/8_/6tdb3p2s63v_xxb15r46cqwr0000gn/T/crimes-eval-agent-2oH6bA/packages/web/src/workspace-client.ts:34) · [API:20–27](/private/var/folders/8_/6tdb3p2s63v_xxb15r46cqwr0000gn/T/crimes-eval-agent-2oH6bA/packages/api/billing/routes.py:20)

6. **Medium — plan definitions disagree, and runtime validation does not enforce either set.**  
   Python defines `free | pro | team | scale`; TypeScript defines `free | pro | enterprise`. Only `free` and `pro` agree. However, the scanner overstates rejection: TypeScript types do not validate `res.json()`, and the API accepts any string—including `enterprise`—because its parameter is `str`, not `Plan`. This permits unsupported values and responses outside the client’s declared type. Generate the client definition from the canonical schema and validate requests at runtime.  
   [Python enum:10](/private/var/folders/8_/6tdb3p2s63v_xxb15r46cqwr0000gn/T/crimes-eval-agent-2oH6bA/packages/api/billing/plans.py:10) · [Client type:10](/private/var/folders/8_/6tdb3p2s63v_xxb15r46cqwr0000gn/T/crimes-eval-agent-2oH6bA/packages/web/src/workspace-client.ts:10) · [API parameter:26](/private/var/folders/8_/6tdb3p2s63v_xxb15r46cqwr0000gn/T/crimes-eval-agent-2oH6bA/packages/api/billing/routes.py:26)

7. **Low — “workspace” and “team” name the same concept.**  
   This spans the client’s interface/functions and Python’s enum documentation/handlers. It creates maintenance ambiguity; the concrete routing failures are counted above. Standardize the terminology or document the mapping. The scanner’s suggested “organization” name is not a contract requirement.

All four client functions also omit `res.ok` checks, so JSON error responses can resolve as apparent successes; `getWorkspace` and `createWorkspace` can return error objects under `Promise<Workspace>`.

The scan’s `getWorkspace` “False Identity” finding is **not a demonstrated contract defect**: performing an HTTP GET is consistent with its name.

Verified the HTTP outcomes using the router in-process with installed FastAPI 0.115.6. No files changed.
